title: token.update
description: Update existing tokens. The tokenid property must be defined for each token; all other properties are optional and only passed properties are updated.

tokenid.description: ID of the token to update.

status.description: Token status. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled token; 1 - disabled token.

expires_at.description: Token expiration date and time. Zero for never-expiring tokens.
